summary:
Full v1→v2 migration executed across Phases 0-7, with Items 1-2 corrections.
    
Completed work:
- Phase 0: Safety checkpoint, migration branch, state tracking
- Phase 1: Lug schema upgraded (350 Lugs), signals absorbed (10), PEV fields added
- Phase 2: Registry structure, manifests, PROJECT.md files
- Phase 3: Skills directory, extension identity, use_cases requirement
- Phase 4: Hub infrastructure, BRIEF cascade (completed in Item 1)
- Phase 5: WAI-Integrity.md data protection contract (completed in Item 1)
- Phase 6: Cross-node signal propagation
- Phase 7: Integration testing, user guide
- Item 1: Spec alignment (PEV field corrections, integrity contract, BRIEF cascade)
- Item 2: Session ledger pattern (append-only commitment tracking)

Architecture changes:
- Signals → Lugs with impact >= 8
- Backpressure → Skills (qc-check, safe-refactor)
- WAI-Integrity.md: Read-only paths, append-only paths, scoped write access
- Session ledger: Prevents context loss and premature completion
- PEV fields: perceive/execute/verify for structured execution
- Extension identity: EXTENSION.md per spoke

Data preservation: All v1 data migrated, backups retained, zero data loss.

Context loss incident: During migration, token exhaustion caused PEV renaming
(perspective/evidence/verdict) and phases 8-9 skipped. Item 1 corrected deviations,
Item 2 installed ledger to prevent recurrence.
